name: Wayfind Brand Asset Vault
rules: Reuse these files; never redraw, approximate, recolor, stretch or regenerate the Wayfind logo when an asset here fits.
Masters are stored exactly as supplied. Put any resized or optimized copy elsewhere and list it here with original=false and derivative_of set.
When the owner supplies a new official asset, add the file unchanged and a row here in the same commit.

assets.purpose: Full wordmark: white "wayfind" with a pink dot on the i and the gradient (yellow, orange, pink, purple) outline pin, on solid black.
assets.source: Supplied by Gabriel Pereira (owner) in the Claude Duet social-media channel, 2026-11-12, as official Wayfind assets; stored byte for byte as received.
assets.usage_notes: Black background is part of the file; use on black or very dark surfaces only. Small (842x270) JPEG: fine for social and video end cards, too small for print.
assets.checksum_note: The social-media channel listed sha256 d94382d46e5afd28e2cec8e46af793742fa685c3bc9d11f14833ff0868c05c52 for this file (same byte size, 31990). The bytes received for the vault hash differently; the image decodes cleanly. Recorded here is the vault copy's own hash.
